FOUNDER PROFILE · DEMO CONTENT

James R. Whitaker

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Supplied demo biography · Not independently verified
Read the company timelineView the document register

The supplied EcoCharge story introduces James Robert Whitaker, known as Jim, as an electrician from Ohio who built a charging business in Central Florida.

It describes a progression from commercial electrical work to fleet charging and the launch of EcoCharge. The focus of the story is practical operation: electricity costs, reliable equipment and understandable reporting.

Clermont, Florida
